Name: Gravestone
Card: A cracked grave marker. Break it before the dead climb back out.

Name: Bone Pile
Card: A heap of rattling bones that wants to stand up again. Scatter it.

Name: Corpse
Card: A fallen body in the way. Clear it with a pincer or wait for it to rot.

Name: Naga Egg
Card: A leathery egg, still warm. Best to break it before it hatches.

Name: Hex Sniper
Card: Ranged precision. Converts [patience] into a [piercing shot] nothing else in the party can match.

Name: Hex Warden
Card: Ranged control. Converts [distance] into [crowd control] that keeps the front line clean.

Name: Hex Stalker
Card: Ranged skirmish. Converts [footwork] into [shots] that keep a whole lane at arm's length.

Name: Chronomancer
Card: Charges [Temporal Drag]: the party loses [tempo] and every foe acts sooner. [Interrupt] the charge, [cleanse] Slowed or [out-haste] it. Rewinds once when badly hurt.

Name: The Hierarch
Card: Charges Tithe Draught, a [drain] on every hero that heals it for each one it touches. [Interrupt] the charge. At half HP the organ pours its reservoir into it. While any of its Choir still stands, it rises once.

Name: Monster Tamer
Card: Wild monsters turn [Tamed] and fight for you.

Name: Herald
Card: Backline [healer]. Free, strong heals paid in her own HP ([Essence]).

Name: Aetherist
Card: Backline [healer]. Mends an ally and pours an orb into the bank.

Name: Tactician
Card: [Countermarch]: a foe's turn goes to the back of the line.

Name: Harpy Raider
Card: Swift [Flanker]: strikes, then darts a tile away. Its talons can [Slow] a hero, costing the party [tempo]. [Pincer] it before it lifts off, or [cleanse] the Slow.

Name: Harpy Shrieker
Card: Charges a [Gale Shriek] that blows heroes apart and breaks your [pincer] lines. [Interrupt] the charge or keep the party spread out. Hastens the harpy it backs as a [Supporter].

Name: Harpy Spotter
Card: Hangs back and fires [shots] at your casters; its darts can [Silence]. It is frail up close: close in and [pincer] it.

Name: Void Sentinel
Card: Charges a [Void Beam] down a marked line that [Silences]: step off the line or [Interrupt] it. Its front is plated, so [pincer] it from the flanks. At half HP its core flares a [Ward].

Name: Lich
Card: Charges [Soulfire] on a 3×3 that [Burns]: spread out or [Interrupt] it. At half HP it harvests every hero to heal. It falls into a grave: smash the grave, or it rises again.

Name: Infernalist Zealot
Card: Its claws can set a hero [Burning], and an Infernalist Executioner hits burning heroes far harder: [cleanse] the burn. Can't be [Burned] itself.

Name: Infernalist Pyromancer
Card: Charges [Hellfire] on a cross of tiles that [Burns]: spread out or [Interrupt] it. Hangs back from the fight.

Name: Infernalist Bloodbinder
Card: Charges a [Blood Rite] that heals and [Empowers] its most wounded ally: kill it first or [Interrupt] the rite. Its blows [Lifesteal].

Name: Infernalist Executioner
Card: Hits [Burning] heroes 50% harder: [cleanse] the burn or keep burning heroes away from it. A duelist: [pincer] it, it hates being outnumbered.

Name: Bulwark Rifleman
Card: Shoots straight down a line from up to 3 tiles away, and a shot can [Blind]: close in and [pincer] it. Weak to Lightning.

Name: Bulwark Shieldbearer
Card: Charges [Aegis Field], a [Ward] on every ally within 2 tiles: [Interrupt] it, and hit it from the flank, not its plate.

Name: Bulwark Siphoner
Card: Charges [Aether Siphon] on your casters, and when it lands an orb leaves your bank: spend your orbs first, or [Interrupt] it.

Name: Bulwark Siege Gunner
Card: Charges a slow [Siege Shot] down a marked line to the board's edge: step off the line or [Interrupt] it. It needs a long rest after.

Name: Watch Sentry
Card: Never leaves its post, and answers a blow from beside it with a chilling [Counterstrike] that can [Slow]: strike from range, or [pincer] it and take the hit. Its grave rises unless smashed.

Name: Watch Reaver
Card: Hunts the weakest hero. The first time it drops low, its oath holds: it heals and gains [Ward]. Finish it in one push, and smash its grave.

Name: Watch Vigilant
Card: Charges [Ember Vigil], [Regen] on every ally within 2 tiles: [Interrupt] it or cut it down first. Fire burns the Watch hardest.

Name: Choir Cantor
Card: Charges the [Tithe Hymn] on the whole party, which can [Silence] every hero it reaches: cast before it lands, [Interrupt] it, or [Cleanse] after.

Name: Choir Psalmist
Card: Charges [Psalm of Certainty], [Empowers] every ally within 2 tiles: [Interrupt] it, or pull its allies away. Quick and frail.

Name: Choir Confessor
Card: Charges [Absolution] on its most wounded ally: a heal, a [Cleanse] of every debuff, and a [Ward]. Kill it first, or [Interrupt] it.

Name: Herd Boss
Card: Charges [Feed the Herd], healing and rushing every ally near it: kill it first or [Interrupt] it. Hangs back behind its crew. [Stampede]: when an ally falls, its next turn comes sooner.

Name: Herd Bouncer
Card: Guards the crew behind a thick front: flank it, not its chest. Its punches can [Slow] a hero. [Stampede]: when an ally falls, its next turn comes sooner.

Name: Herd Gorer
Card: Charges a [Bull Rush] down a marked line to the board's edge: step off the line or [Interrupt] it. [Stampede]: when an ally falls, its next turn comes sooner.

Name: Herd Breaker
Card: Charges in and never backs off; below half HP it hits harder (Berserk): finish it in one push. [Stampede]: when an ally falls, its next turn comes sooner.

Name: Hellspawn Ravager
Card: [Bloodscent]: hits a hero below half HP 50% harder, and goes for the weakest: keep the party topped up. Can't be [Burned].

Name: Hellspawn Drinker
Card: [Bloodscent]: hits a hero below half HP 50% harder. Strikes then darts away, healing on every blow ([Lifesteal]): [pincer] it when it lands. Can't be [Burned].

Name: Hellspawn Emberheart
Card: Charges a [Red Tide] that floods its target's whole row and sets everyone in it [Burning]: leave the row or [Interrupt] it. [Bloodscent]. Can't be [Burned].

Name: Hellspawn Scaleback
Card: Strike it up close and it may set you [Burning] (Searing Scales); flank its scaled front. [Bloodscent]. Never retreats. Can't be [Burned].

Name: Holdwright
Card: Steady [engineer]. Raises barricades and props up [guardian] lines.

Name: Hold Marksman
Card: Patient [striker]. Fires over the walls with a [piercing shot].

Name: Shardcaller
Card: Distant [controller]. Calls shard strikes down on the party.

Name: Crystal Brute
Card: Slow [bruiser]. Walks through shard strikes and seeds crystal where it falls.

Name: Shard Skitter
Card: Quick [flanker]. Brings a shard strike down on whoever pins it.

Name: Chain Warden
Card: Patient [controller]. Hauls the anchor to wherever the party stands.

Name: Anchor Hulk
Card: Immovable [guardian]. The heave never moves it.

Name: Hookthrower
Card: Wiry [controller]. Hooks one hero out of the line.

Name: Tidestrider
Card: Quick [flanker]. The flood never slows it.

Name: Stormcaller
Card: Distant [controller]. Sends lightning through the floodwater.

Name: Bloated Drowner
Card: Swollen [bruiser]. Bursts into floodwater and hurries the tide.

Name: Spire Burrower
Card: Tunnelling [brawler]. Leaves cracked floor wherever it goes.

Name: Pit Lurker
Card: Patient [pouncer]. Never falls, and caves the floor in where it dies.

Name: Floorbreaker
Card: Heavy [bruiser]. Cracks the floor under a hero and shoves them across it.

Name: Lamp Snuffer
Card: Sly [controller]. Puts out the braziers and blinds.

Name: Dusk Stalker
Card: Quick [striker]. Hunts from the dark; its eyes light the ground where it falls.

Name: Gloom Mender
Card: Unseen [healer]. Mends its allies from out of sight.
